raw_Final.answer: The net change in Entergy Mississippi, Inc.'s net revenue during 2003 was an increase of $46.4 million.
raw_Final.message: 2003 net revenue ($426.6 million) minus 2002 net revenue ($380.2 million) = $46.4 million increase. This agrees with the component movements: base rates +$48.3 million and other -$1.9 million, i.e. 380.2 + 48.3 - 1.9 = 426.6, confirming the $46.4 million net change.
